caption: The drawing depicts a single ornate wooden chair, shown from a frontal view and centered on the page. The chair features an elaborately carved high backrest with multiple vertical spindles, decorative top rails, and curved armrests that extend outward and then downward to connect to the seat. The seat appears to be contoured, and the legs are turned with cross-stretchers connecting them for added stability. The chair's legs are splayed outward slightly and have additional carved details. The drawing is rendered in fine, precise black lines on an off-white or light beige background. There are some faint stains and marks on the paper, mainly at the top and right upper edges, but no other objects are present in the composition.
title: Chinese Cane Chair
